templates.description: Self-hosted platform of autonomous, persistent personal AI agents that collaborate, remember, and build their own tools. Reachable via Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Signal and Matrix. Single container with Bun and SQLite, no external infrastructure. Source: https://github.com/MarlBurroW/hivekeep

env.label: Bind address — keep 0.0.0.0 so the port mapping is reachable
env.name: HOST

env.label: External URL for links and webhooks
env.name: PUBLIC_URL

templates.name: hivekeep
templates.note: LLM provider keys are added in-app after first-run onboarding, not via environment. If the app is unreachable after deploy, ensure HOST=0.0.0.0.
templates.title: Hivekeep
